fields.summary_ko.0: Texas Instruments (TXN) is issuing $2 billion in new debt to finance the Silicon Laboratories acquisition; at current price of $311.49 versus target price of $435.69, the stock appears undervalued by 29%.
fields.summary_ko.1: Total shareholder return over one year has reached 94.58%; the company is strengthening long-term competitive advantages through expanded 300mm analog manufacturing capacity in the United States.
